descriptions.inProgress: I met #bAlcaster#k, the archaeologist, at El Nath. He said he had heard about the #bBook of Ancient#k, which tells about the Great World War, happened hundreds years ago. Interesting... The only living descendant of the author of the "Book of Ancient"  #bHella#k who lives in Orbis. I better go to find her right now~
